author: Quaternius
pack: Ultimate Modular Men (license file calls it Ultimate Modular Males)
retrieval_note: Official Google Drive download returned quota exceeded. Retrieved the CC0 original from a public mirror with its pack license; no quota circumvention.
adaptations: Collapsed 62 source skin joints to existing 15 runtime nodes; up to 4 weights.
Adjusted head and body proportions, segment fit and smoothed cloth normals.
Recoloured authored hoodie, shorts/leg surfaces and shoes using vertex colours. Lower-leg recolour is a legging treatment, not new trouser geometry.
Retained original locally authored lantern and ribbon accessories, procedural movement and foot-height solver.

Baked relaxed finger curl through original finger joints, reduced hand size 16%, then collapsed to the existing forearm. Lantern moved 0.07 metres towards the hoodie; original 24-triangle shoulder straps added.

Corrected offline foot bind matrices: remove each source Foot bone local +Y horizontal yaw (L 58.795975 deg, R 6.628508 deg) before shoe scaling. Vertices, weights, topology, source mesh and runtime motion unchanged.
runtime: Fixed C++ data only; no model loader, texture, shader or asset access added at runtime.
animations: Source includes 24 clips. None are bundled into runtime motion; existing run/jump/slide/landing poses drive the retargeted mesh.
